description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Special' class, a controller for handling special product listings in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It processes request parameters for sorting, pagination, builds the product list with details like images, prices, and URLs, and manages pagination links and SEO-related rel tags.

classes.name: Special
classes.description: Controller class responsible for displaying special products, handling sorting, pagination, and product data preparation for the view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that handles processing request parameters, fetching special products data, building product array for display, managing pagination, sorting, and SEO links.
